claims: As of late March 2026, the 30-year fixed average mortgage rate is hovering around 6.5% to 6.6%, according to Bankrate and Mortgage News Daily.
As of March 29-30, 2026, the average 30-Year Fixed mortgage rate is ~6.56%.
Bankrate and Mortgage News Daily report the 30-Year Fixed mortgage rate ranging between 6.56% and 6.64% as of March 29-30, 2026.
As of March 29-30, 2026, the average 15-Year Fixed mortgage rate is ~6.03% to 6.12%.
As of March 29-30, 2026, the average FHA 30-Year Fixed mortgage rate is ~6.29% to 6.64%.
As of March 29-30, 2026, the average VA 30-Year Fixed mortgage rate is ~6.50%.
As of March 29-30, 2026, the average 5/1 ARM mortgage rate is ~5.71% to 7.40%.
In Virginia, the 30-year fixed mortgage rate was roughly 6.66% recently.
